newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April industrial output falls prelim 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan April industrial output falls prelim 0.4 pct.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in April fell a preliminary 0.4 percent from the previous month on a seasonally adjusted basis, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.
MITI said in a statement that although industrial production had slowed for temporary reasons, it continues to rise strongly in year-on-year terms, and in general terms is on a gradual rising trend.
